{{Top}}
'''Synthstones''' were the measure of payment used by [[Cestus Cybernetics]] to acquire its vast holdings on [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Cestus]] from the [[X'Ting]].

Presumably they were cheap facsimilies of actual gems, as [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] law determined that their use by Cestus Cybernetics was equivalent to counterfeit money.
